tracks.title: Spend Basics
tracks.description: Find your way around Spend and record your first supplier bill.

scenarios.title: Find your way around
scenarios.description: A short walk through the sidebar: where expenses, bills and reports live.

steps.title: Welcome to Spend
steps.body: Everything in Spend belongs to the company picked here. During training you work in the Spend Training company, so nothing reaches your real books.

steps.title: Open Expenses
steps.body: Expenses are money spent without a supplier bill, such as petty cash. Click Expenses.
steps.hint: It's in the sidebar, under Accounts.

steps.title: Open Bills
steps.body: Bills are invoices from suppliers that you pay later. Click Bills.
steps.hint: It's in the sidebar, under Purchasing.

steps.title: Open Reports
steps.body: Reports show spending by account, cost center and project. Click Reports.
steps.hint: It's at the bottom of the sidebar, under Setup.

quiz.question: Where do you record an invoice a supplier sent you?
quiz.explanation: Bills track what you owe a supplier until you pay it.

scenarios.title: Record a supplier bill
scenarios.description: Record a bill from Acme Stationers for 10 reams of printer paper and save it as a draft.

steps.title: Start a new bill
steps.body: Acme Stationers sent an invoice for printer paper. Click New Bill.

steps.title: Pick the supplier
steps.hint: Type 'Acme' and pick it from the list.

steps.title: Enter the invoice number
steps.body: Type the number printed on the supplier's invoice, for example INV-1001. It helps find the bill later.

steps.title: Check the total
steps.body: Spend works out the total for you: 10 × 250 = 2,500.

steps.title: Save the draft
steps.body: Click Save Draft. A draft doesn't post to the ledger yet, so it can still be changed.

quiz.question: Does a draft bill post to the ledger?
quiz.options:
Yes, as soon as it is saved
No, only when it is submitted
quiz.correct_option: No, only when it is submitted
quiz.explanation: Drafts can be changed freely. Submitting (or approval) posts the bill.
